title: A Promising App for Building and Sticking to Routines
body:
I’ve had a really positive experience with FocusBear so far. It’s been genuinely helpful in shaping and fixing my daily routine, and the reminders do a great job of pulling me back on track whenever I drift. I’ve only been using the app for about two days, but even in that short time it’s made a noticeable difference.
The layout feels clean and intuitive, which makes it easy to get started without feeling overwhelmed. I’m mainly focused on improving my current routine, and the app fits that purpose well. That said, I think the quick breaks feature has room to be improved or expanded to make it even more effective.
I’m still getting familiar with all the features, but I’d definitely recommend FocusBear to anyone who wants to build better routines and actually stick to them. After a few days of use, once everything starts to click, the app becomes really handy and helps make each day feel just a little more productive and better than the last.
author: Arjun Poonia

title: A genuinely helpful app especially for ADHD!!!
body:
Focus Bear has quickly become one of the most effective productivity apps I’ve used. It’s clear this app was designed by people who actually understand how hard focus and consistency can be, especially if you have ADHD.

I love how it combines distraction blocking with gentle, real-time habit guidance instead of just timers and to-do lists. The morning routines help me start the day with intention, and the smart breaks make it easier to stay in deep work without burning out. Blocking distractions across devices is a game changer, and it feels supportive rather than restrictive.

What really sets Focus Bear apart is how human it feels- encouraging, structured, and realistic. It doesn’t try to shame you into productivity; it helps you build better habits at your own pace.

Highly recommend!!!

author: Tobestermils

title: Helping You Stay Focused in a World Full of Distractions
body:
Focus Bear has been a genuinely impactful app for me. Using it helped me step away from constant social media use and made me more aware of how often I was mindlessly scrolling. Over time, I started recognising when to avoid these habits, something I feel many people my age struggle with without even realising how much time gets consumed by online distractions. The app helped me create a much-needed mental reset and spend my time more intentionally on other activities.

The focus session restrictions are especially effective. In strict mode, the app prevents access to selected distracting apps until a goal is completed, which works as a strong and timely reminder to stay on track. It also supported me in building a daily routine, something I previously struggled with due to poor time awareness and lack of structured planning.

I believe this app has helped me regain a sense of control over how I use my time and attention, which I now truly value. 

I would strongly recommend it to anyone looking to reduce their dependence on social media and regain focus. 

In a world where algorithms are designed purely to maximise engagement, often without regard for the quality of content we consume, Focus Bear feels like a practical and empowering tool to stay mindful, focused, and consistent with personal goals.

author: Fardaad.

title: Excellent Productivity App
body:
Focus Bear has not only helped me remain productive while studying/working, but has also helped me fixed my morning and night routines. Its automatic blocking feature has been a blessing to my routine for the past couple of months, and I no longer find myself doom-scrolling before bed or right after getting up in the morning. I have not only found myself having more time in the day to commit to my work and studies throughout the day a result, but also have witnessed improvements in my mood and energy levels.

I also like that the app gives us the flexibility to turn off the blocking for a limited period of time so that we could use a blocked app in case of emergency or just to please ourselves temporarily. After the timer ends, Focus Bear blocks the app so that I can get back to focusing on my tasks at hand. 

However, I would like to highlight that this feature does not always work as intended. The app does not resume blocking automatically after the chosen time, even when the phone stays on. Nevertheless, blocking does resume once I open the app again after the timer expires.

The tasks feature is also very handy. I like that we can assign energy levels to each task and filter them according to which tasks will take more or less energy. The ability to organize our tasks into categories called 'projects' is also very handy. 

The app also has a stats page that shows users how much progress they are making in terms of setting/following good habits and carrying out focus sessions. I feel like this is a very powerful feature that could encourage many users to engage more with the app, but it ends up awkwardly hidden in the settings tab. These metrics, such as focus streak and habit stats, should maybe be displayed in the homepage, so that users wont have to look for them maybe even never find them throughout their time of using this app.

All in all, Focus Bear is an outstanding productivity app. In an age full of distractions and sedentary habits, this app offers practical tools to help people build routines, stay focused, and organize their workloads. While it has a few minor flaws, its overall impact is overwhelmingly positive. I will give it a rating of 5/5.

They also have a micro break feature that reminds you to get active after sitting for an extended period of time which is important for our health! There are videos that you can follow along which I found really useful as I do not have to decide what exercise to perform.
